note: Where each data file in app/data came from (paths relative to the full app's hw-Final-2 folder). Each file keeps its own source URLs inside.

state_tax.json.change: kept name, top rate and effective-rate grid per state

wages.json.change: kept national 25th/50th/75th pay per occupation, state pay ratio, job phrases

basics.json.change: kept state and US rows (no counties), food, transport, health out-of-pocket by age, Medicare Part B and D premiums

social_security.json.copied_from: written by hand from data/sources/ssa_pia_formula.txt, ssa_wage_base.txt, ssa_benefit_reduction.txt, ssa_delayed_credits.txt

households.json.copied_from: output/synth_tree/raw/*.json (347 fast plans) and output/synth_tree_full/raw/*.json (120 full plans), profiles from output/synth_run3/personas.jsonl.gz and data/profiles; parsing as in docs/LITE_NEIGHBOR_CHECK.md
households.json.change: kept matching features, plan a decisions (stock share by age, claim age offset, products) and outcomes

passages.json.copied_from: verbatim passages from data/sources/*.txt with URLs from data/sources/catalog.json
